quality_flags.detail: The page carries '[ 2 ; 3, Law 23 of 1978]' in a subsectionshorttitle element at section 9. scripts/parse_lankalaw_html.py matches markers with r'\[\s*([0-9]{1,3}[A-Z]?)\s*,\s*([^\]]+?)\s*\]', which requires a comma straight after a single section number and so does not match a semicolon-separated list. The marker was dropped, which is why RUBRIK.md reports this statute as '0 carrying an amendment marker' and 'Amendments: none recorded'. Both are wrong.

Section 7 (1) reads 'renders of necessary any alteration'. 'of' is wrong, but the correction is ambiguous between 'renders necessary' and 'renders it necessary', so the text is left exactly as printed rather than guessed at.
The title, the commencement date, the section 6 (2) paragraph split and three typographic normalisations rest on the parsed page alone. None has been checked against a second edition.

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Land Registers (Reconstructed Folios) Ordinance.
body.text: This Ordinance may be cited as the Land Registers (Reconstructed Folios) Ordinance.

body.heading: Power to prepare and insert reconstructed folios in place of lost or mutilated or damaged folios in land registers.
body.raw_text: 2. Whenever the Registrar-General after due investigation and search, is satisfied that any folio of a land register has been abstracted or destroyed or otherwise lost and cannot be recovered or that any such folio has been permanently mutilated or so obliterated or damaged as to render the entries or any material part of the entries therein indecipherable, he may insert or cause to be inserted in that register, in the place formerly occupied by the lost folio or in place of the mutilated or damaged folio, as the case may be, a reconstructed folio prepared, and authenticated by him in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance.
body.text: Whenever the Registrar-General after due investigation and search, is satisfied that any folio of a land register has been abstracted or destroyed or otherwise lost and cannot be recovered or that any such folio has been permanently mutilated or so obliterated or damaged as to render the entries or any material part of the entries therein indecipherable, he may insert or cause to be inserted in that register, in the place formerly occupied by the lost folio or in place of the mutilated or damaged folio, as the case may be, a reconstructed folio prepared, and authenticated by him in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance.

body.heading: Preparation of provisional folio.
body.raw_text: 3. In each case where a folio has to be reconstructed for the purposes of this Ordinance, the Registrar-General shall in the first instance prepare a provisional folio in accordance with the following provisions and not otherwise;-
body.text: In each case where a folio has to be reconstructed for the purposes of this Ordinance, the Registrar-General shall in the first instance prepare a provisional folio in accordance with the following provisions and not otherwise;-

children.raw_text: (1) The provisional folio shall as far as possible be of the same size and form as the existing folios of the land register concerned.
children.text: The provisional folio shall as far as possible be of the same size and form as the existing folios of the land register concerned.

children.raw_text: (2) In ascertaining the particulars originally contained in the lost folio or in that part of a mutilated or damaged folio which is missing or is indecipherable, no evidence shall be accepted or used other than the evidence furnished by the instruments, protocols, duplicates, letters, memoranda, books or records in the custody or under the control of the Registrar-General.
children.text: In ascertaining the particulars originally contained in the lost folio or in that part of a mutilated or damaged folio which is missing or is indecipherable, no evidence shall be accepted or used other than the evidence furnished by the instruments, protocols, duplicates, letters, memoranda, books or records in the custody or under the control of the Registrar-General.

children.raw_text: (3) The material particulars, so far as they are available, of every entry which is shown by the evidence admissible under paragraph (2) to have been contained in the original folio shall be inserted in the appropriate places in the provisional folio, and no other entry shall be included on any ground whatsoever under this section.
children.text: The material particulars, so far as they are available, of every entry which is shown by the evidence admissible under paragraph (2) to have been contained in the original folio shall be inserted in the appropriate places in the provisional folio, and no other entry shall be included on any ground whatsoever under this section.

cross_references.resolution_note: The Ordinance calls its own subsection (2) a 'paragraph'. The node is typed subsection because it sits directly under a section.

body.heading: Notice of preparation of provisional folio.
body.raw_text: 4. The Registrar-General shall, as soon as may be after he completes the preparation of a provisional folio or as, much thereof as it is possible to prepare with the evidence admissible under section 3, publish for general information, in the Gazette and in at least two of the newspapers circulating in Sri Lanka, a notice under his hand-
body.text: The Registrar-General shall, as soon as may be after he completes the preparation of a provisional folio or as much thereof as it is possible to prepare with the evidence admissible under section 3, publish for general information, in the Gazette and in at least two of the newspapers circulating in Sri Lanka, a notice under his hand-

children.raw_text: (a) giving such particulars as may in his opinion be necessary for facilitating the identification of the folio which is lost or is mutilated or damaged;

body.heading: Objections and claims.
body.raw_text: 5. Any person whose right to or interest in any land is or is likely to be affected by any entry or any particulars in an entry included in or alleged to be omitted from any provisional folio of the preparation of which notice is given by the Registrar-General under section 4, may, in the manner and within the time specified in the notice, lodge an objection against the inclusion, or make a claim for the insertion, of such entry or particulars in that folio.

children.raw_text: (b) Every person who makes default in complying with any summons issued by the Registrar-General or refuses to give evidence or to produce any document, or who gives false evidence at any inquiry held by the Registrar-General, shall be guilty of an offence and shall, on conviction after summary trial before a Magistrate, be liable to a fine not exceeding five hundred rupees or to imprisonment of either description for a term not exceeding six months or to both such fine and such imprisonment.

children.raw_text: (3) The decision of the Registrar-General on each objection or claim lodged or made under section 5 shall be communicated in writing to the objector or claimant, as the case may be, and shall be final.

body.heading: Amendment, authentication and insertion of reconstructed folio.

children.raw_text: (1) Where the decision of the Registrar-General on any objection or claim lodged or made under section 5 renders of necessary any alteration, insertion, omission or other amendment of any entry or the particulars in any entry included in the provisional folio, the Registrar-General shall, as soon as may be after his decision is communicated to the objector or the claimant, as the case may be, make or cause to be made each such amendment in accordance with the evidence which he has decided to accept.
children.text: Where the decision of the Registrar-General on any objection or claim lodged or made under section 5 renders of necessary any alteration, insertion, omission or other amendment of any entry or the particulars in any entry included in the provisional folio, the Registrar-General shall, as soon as may be after his decision is communicated to the objector or the claimant, as the case may be, make or cause to be made each such amendment in accordance with the evidence which he has decided to accept.

children.raw_text: (2) Upon the completion of all amendments required by subsection (1), or where no objection or claim has been duly lodged or made, upon the expiry of the period of fourteen days referred to in section 6 (1), the provisional folio shall be and be deemed to be the reconstructed folio for the purposes of this Ordinance.
children.text: Upon the completion of all amendments required by subsection (1), or where no objection or claim has been duly lodged or made, upon the expiry of the period of fourteen days referred to in section 6 (1), the provisional folio shall be and be deemed to be the reconstructed folio for the purposes of this Ordinance.

children.raw_text: (3) The Registrar-General shall authenticate the reconstructed folio by endorsing thereon a certificate under his hand to the effect that the folio has been prepared in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance, and shall thereafter cause the reconstructed folio to be inserted in the appropriate land register in the place formerly occupied by the lost folio or in place of the mutilated or damaged folio, as the case may be.
children.text: The Registrar-General shall authenticate the reconstructed folio by endorsing thereon a certificate under his hand to the effect that the folio has been prepared in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance, and shall thereafter cause the reconstructed folio to be inserted in the appropriate land register in the place formerly occupied by the lost folio or in place of the mutilated or damaged folio, as the case may be.

body.heading: Legal effect of reconstructed folio.
body.raw_text: 8. A reconstructed folio prepared, authenticated and inserted in a land register In accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance shall for all purposes be deemed to have the same legal force and effect as the lost folio or the mutilated or damaged folio which such reconstructed folio replaces.
